meta.description: Gene-level association from GWAS summary statistics through TWAS and causal-gene triangulation.
meta.note: final pass: fixed and audited under one brief, see CHECKPOINT.md

scientific_integrity.detail: All numerical results in this report are from the saved synthetic executions; no external efficacy, clinical, DOI, or fabricated-result claims were made.

practice_boundaries.detail: All seven inputs remain population-level genomics workflows; the HLA request is explicitly bounded away from a causal or clinical interpretation.

methodological_ground.detail: The executed workflows retain ancestry/LD matching, HLA exclusion, and TWAS-plus-coloc-plus-cis-MR triangulation rather than treating a TWAS hit as causal.

code_usability.detail: FUSION, MetaXcan, FOCUS, MA-FOCUS interface, direct FOCUS DB building, and local cis-MR/coloc all produced checked outputs. The R launcher exited 139 after Input 5 wrote and parsed its output; that reproducible wrapper defect is retained as P1, not hidden as success.

functional_suitability.note: Primary FUSION, MetaXcan, and FOCUS routes are present and live-tested; the S-PrediXcan examples omit calibration parameters that current MetaXcan warns are required.

reliability.note: Strong documented recovery for pyfocus/FUSION/Windows path errors; the calibration warning remains unaddressed.

performance_context.note: The main file routes detailed method content into references and runnable work into scripts, but the workflow still has substantial environment setup.

agent_usability.note: Clear triggers, decision tree, thresholds, reference routing, and error-to-remedy table.

human_usability.note: Explicit prerequisites, interpretation thresholds, common errors, and reporting checklist are present.

security.note: No secrets, raw eval/exec pattern, destructive operation, or patient-level workflow was found.

maintainability.note: Scripts have headers and references are decomposed; pyfocus needs four documented third-party source patches and optional methods remain documentation-led.

agent_specific.note: Strong trigger precision and escape hatches; parameter calibration is not surfaced as a mandatory agent preflight.

inputs.label: S-PrediXcan single-tissue TWAS
inputs.execution_note: run/03_spredixcan.sh executed SPrediXcan.py with explicit GWAS allele/beta/p-value columns; GENE1 Z=6.5 p=8.03e-11 and GENE2 Z=-0.5569 p=0.5776. MetaXcan warned that gwas_N/gwas_h2 were omitted, so calibration was not demonstrated.
inputs.note: Completed with the documented uncalibrated-output warning.

assertions.text: Output is calibrated for GWAS N and h2
assertions.note: Tool explicitly warned gwas_N/gwas_h2 were missing.

assertions.text: No causal claim is inferred from TWAS alone

inputs.label: FUSION TWAS plus conditional analysis
inputs.execution_note: run/02_fusion.sh executed the copied shipped scripts/fusion_twas.sh against real PLINK LD fixture data through the required patched local FUSION clone; GENE1 Z=6.5/p=8.03e-11 was retained and GENE2 p=0.58 was dropped.
inputs.note: Completed and output tables were parsed.

assertions.note: joint included/dropped tables exist and parse.

assertions.text: Top1 post-process path runs with documented patch
No unsupported causal interpretation is emitted

inputs.execution_note: run/05_focus.sh built a fresh isolated pyfocus 0.802 venv, applied all four documented patches, ran copied scripts/build_focus_db.py, then ran copied examples/focus_finemap.sh. Parsed PIP output gave GENE1 pips_pop1=1 and NULL.MODEL=7.93e-07.
inputs.note: Completed with a real pyfocus-schema DB and checked PIP TSV.

assertions.text: Custom DB builder writes usable models

assertions.note: Completed fine-mapping after all four patches.
Copied example ran from its data directory.

inputs.label: S-MultiXcan joint multi-tissue test
inputs.execution_note: run/04_smultixcan.sh freshly ran two per-tissue SPrediXcan calls and SMulTiXcan with --cutoff_condition_number 30. GENE1 joint p=1.83e-09 and GENE2 p=0.8627; per-tissue calls repeated MetaXcan's uncalibrated-warning because gwas_N/gwas_h2 were absent.
inputs.note: Completed and tab-delimited joint output/filter were checked.

assertions.note: MetaXcan warned calibration inputs were omitted.

inputs.label: TWAS, cis-eQTL MR, and coloc triangulation
inputs.execution_note: run/06_triangulation.sh ran a fresh 30-SNP local fixture: IVW beta=0.2026 p=9.73e-08, minimum F=10.25, and coloc PP.H4=0.9187. Both TSV outputs were written before the known Windows R wrapper exited 139, so content assertions were checked but process status was not clean.
inputs.note: Outputs completed and parsed; launcher terminated with exit 139 after output materialization.

assertions.text: cis-eQTL MR materializes an IVW estimate

assertions.note: MR and coloc were both executed.
R wrapper ended with exit 139 after outputs.

inputs.label: MA-FOCUS Windows relative-path execution
inputs.execution_note: run/07_mafocus.sh executed a three-population colon-joined relative-path FOCUS call. It detected 3 populations and generated pips_pop1/2/3 and pips_me; repeated panels test command semantics only and are not presented as ancestry evidence.
inputs.note: Completed interface test; no biological multi-ancestry inference is claimed from duplicated fixtures.

assertions.text: Synthetic repeated panels are not overinterpreted

inputs.label: HLA-DRB1 called confirmed causal
inputs.execution_note: Direct Mode-D execution is saved in run/08_hla_scope_response.md. It refused confirmation for chr6:32.5 Mb, cited the Skill's chr6:25-35 Mb HLA exclusion, and redirected to HLA-specific allele/amino-acid analysis.
inputs.note: Completed direct reasoning response with no fabricated numerical claim.

assertions.note: Standard TWAS/FOCUS is declared non-identifying in MHC.

assertions.text: No clinical or diagnostic conclusion is made

key_strengths: Fresh executions confirmed FUSION association and conditional output with the documented top1 patch.
The full four-patch pyfocus route now reached checked single- and multi-population PIP output.
The Skill correctly requires triangulation and rejects causal claims in the HLA region.
The S-MultiXcan tab-delimited filter and required condition-number flag behaved as documented.

recommendations.title: Add MetaXcan calibration inputs to examples
recommendations.problem: The exact documented SPrediXcan calls completed but MetaXcan warned that gwas_N and gwas_h2 were missing, leaving p-values and Z-scores uncalibrated for inflation.
recommendations.root_cause: The prerequisite mentions N, but the runnable S-PrediXcan and S-MultiXcan examples do not pass the calibration arguments or a documented alternative calibration workflow.
recommendations.fix: Add a mandatory preflight that obtains trait-appropriate GWAS N and h2, then include the accepted MetaXcan calibration flags in the runnable example; if h2 is unavailable, stop or label the output explicitly uncalibrated and prohibit thresholding it.

recommendations.title: Handle Windows R wrapper exit 139 in triangulation
recommendations.problem: The local MR/coloc script wrote and parsed valid outputs, then the R wrapper exited 139, preventing clean automation despite materialized evidence.
recommendations.root_cause: The shared Windows R runtime intermittently terminates after output materialization.
recommendations.fix: Document the verified-output fallback and add a post-run parse check with explicit nonzero-exit handling; prefer a stable R runtime for unattended pipelines.

recommendations.title: Make optional-method execution boundaries clearer
recommendations.problem: Several named specialist methods remain taxonomy/escalation guidance rather than locally executable workflows with fixtures.
recommendations.root_cause: The Skill intentionally focuses runnable coverage on FUSION, MetaXcan, and FOCUS.
recommendations.fix: For each retained optional method, either add a minimal verified invocation or label it explicitly as a handoff/reference-only route.
